contexts.title: Regional haze situation report
contexts.summaryId: Kabut asap lintas batas sedang hingga pekat dilaporkan di sebagian Semenanjung Malaysia, Kalimantan, Sumatra dan Sarawak selatan. Kabut juga diamati di bagian Papua, Maluku dan Sulawesi.
contexts.summaryEn: Moderate to dense transboundary smoke haze was reported over parts of Peninsular Malaysia, Kalimantan, Sumatra and southern Sarawak. Haze was also observed over parts of Papua, Maluku and Sulawesi.

contexts.title: Haze situation update
contexts.summaryId: Kabut asap dari Kalimantan dan Sumatra teramati di kawasan sekitar Singapura. Sebagian berada di lapisan lebih tinggi, dengan pencampuran terbatas ke permukaan.
contexts.summaryEn: Smoke haze from Kalimantan and Sumatra was observed over the surrounding region. Some haze was at higher altitudes above Singapore, with limited mixing to surface levels.

contexts.title: Jakarta smoke observation report
contexts.summaryId: Siaran resmi BMKG menyatakan citra satelit melihat asap sesaat memasuki Jawa bagian barat, termasuk Jabodetabek, pada 16 Okt dan mulai menjauh pada 17 Okt.
contexts.summaryEn: BMKG's official release says satellite imagery briefly showed smoke entering western Java, including Greater Jakarta, on Oct 16, and moving away on Oct 17.

contexts.title: Health-impact report
contexts.summaryId: Angka kasus ISPA adalah laporan kesehatan kumulatif, bukan jumlah penduduk terpapar dan bukan batas plume.
contexts.summaryEn: ARI case counts are cumulative health reports, not counts of exposed people or plume boundaries.

notes.method: This is a 24-hour capture window ending at capturedAt. Records without a valid timestamp or verifiable HTTP(S) source are excluded. At most 40 recent in-period news headlines are retained and truncation is flagged. Missing or failed feeds are unavailable, not zero.
